component: Recovery-aware native capacity, persisted retry and original retirement wakeup
status: tested component on draft recovery branch; not deployed; not autoship restoration
main_component_integrated: 675be536 diagnostics and 743942c9 retry/wakeup, with 25bcb01f retirement-before-observation behavior adapted to the existing original-ledger and terminal-cleanup authorities.
problem: A pending native transfer reserves growth in the existing ledger. Reusing main storage inspection without that reservation reports capacity available even when actual native admission refuses.
behavior: Actual native admission and read-only readiness share the reservation boundary evaluator, including transfer growth in reserved, stored and filesystem ceilings.
The observer validates the exact current original store and complete bounded transfer history and uses the same growth sum as admission. It does not initialize or migrate a namespace.
Missing, corrupt, busy or incompatible evidence remains unavailable without a usable capacity fingerprint.
Reports are observations, never native execution, cleanup, original-input replay or merge capabilities.
Persist native refusal backoff and rotating bounded wakeup without changing original authorization, owner controls, meaningful progress, model charges or merge allowance.

The free sweep retains original-bound retirement and native terminal-cleanup reconciliation, then prunes already-authorized runtimes before read-only capacity observation. It takes native locks with no workflow mutex or transaction held.

Cleanup opens only an established, validated current original namespace. Missing authority is retained, never initialized or migrated. Optional cleanup/wake errors stay logged and do not hide previously completed retirement work.
Fresh unpublished session ownership borrows the held state lock through pure intent validation. Failure cleans only that newly allocated session; resume never receives this guard.
Consume the cleanup guard before the first launch-intent publication attempt and release the state lock before journal callbacks. Failed or uncertain publication retains original runtime context.

red.result: Failed with actual pending original reservation: capacity-observed instead of capacity-exhausted.

additional_cases: Actual transfer commit frees reservation and changes fingerprint.
Corrupt original request hash refuses observation without mutation.
Missing original ledger with retained epoch remains missing; no new database is created.
Both provider admission audits report actual storage blocker before executable setup.
A genuine original-store initial registration and terminal retirement authorize only the fixture owner.
Held original session lock prevents pruning and command wakeup; unlock permits actual removal and shared command queue wake.
An unrelated incomplete runtime and alias retain their exact ownership bytes.
Wake preserves binding, evidence, generation, progress clock, model accounting and merge allowance.
Removing the original namespace epoch refuses cleanup without reinitialization or mutation of retained data; optional failure preserves already completed scheduling work.

retirement_wake_red.result: Original authorized retirement did not wake deferred command after its session lock was released.

pre_intent_constructor.red: Invalid native session declaration stranded a fresh Codex runtime before a durable intent was recorded.
pre_intent_constructor.green: Both-provider regression passed; empty, overlong and non-graphic session IDs leave no fresh runtime or launch directory.
pre_intent_constructor.preservation: A successful prepared launch and a workflow-journal acknowledgement failure retain original runtime bytes and the actual committed launch receipt.
pre_intent_constructor.full_cli_scope: Full CLI suite above is the preceding composition; the constructor follow-up was verified through full core and production CLI compilation.

limits: No production legacy runtime was removed or retired.
No native guest or paid provider acceptance is established by these unit/controller fixtures.

This is not a full merge of #1906. Pre-intent constructor cleanup is integrated; constructor failures at/after publication and post-prepare nonrelease disposal still require an original-intent-aware join before recovery rollout.
Productive successor owner guard and full source/resource/input closure plus CLI/Discord/fault/soak acceptance remain open.
